summary: Split tally/reports.py into the tally/reports/ package (errors, tables, state, system, formatting, model, loading, aggregate, renderers, cli, plus an __init__ that only re-exports the public API), with every file under 400 lines, an acyclic layered import graph, and no private names re-exported. The 63 unit tests pass, and 342 CLI runs (stdout, stderr and exit status) match the original byte for byte, apart from uncaught-traceback paths, which cannot match.
